summary: AGI Inc, a Brazilian foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE under AGBK since its February 2026 IPO, furnished a Form 6-K carrying its third-quarter 2026 earnings release dated November 11, 2026. Results cited include 62.8% QoQ growth in pre-tax earnings, 37.8% QoQ growth in net income to R$276.0 million, and an active customer base of 8.3 million, alongside a 10.0% share of INSS payroll credit. The release references the appointment of Rafael Siqueira as Chief Technology Officer, a routine hire, not a forced departure. No transaction, board recommendation, or deal terms are stated; no special-situation angle or risk-arb consideration applies.
